basic_details.short_information: Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram (RCC Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala, has invited applications for 6 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. RCC/60/2026/ADMN.1. The posts include Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology), Assistant Professor (Medical Oncology), Assistant Professor (Radiodiagnosis), Assistant Professor (Radiation Oncology). Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Download the application form in Word format from www.rcctvm.gov.in.
Enter all the required details, take a printout and sign the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, caste, non-creamy layer (if applicable), qualifications, experience, Medical Council registration and other testimonials.
Enclose a Demand Draft for Rs. 2,500/- (Rs. 1,000/- for SC/ST) in favour of the Director, Regional Cancer Centre, payable at SBI, Medical College Branch, Thiruvananthapuram.
Superscribe the envelope 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT PROFESSOR IN ______ (SPECIALITY)'.
Send by Speed Post to The Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Medical College P.O, Post Box No.2417, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695011, to reach by 13-11-2026, 3.00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RCC Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RCC Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology), 2 Assistant Professor (Medical Oncology), 2 Assistant Professor (Radiodiagnosis), 1 Assistant Professor (Radiation Oncology).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RCC Thiruvananthapuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form in Word format on the official website www.rcctvm.gov.in) and send it to The Director, Regional Cancer Centre, Medical College P.O, Post Box No.2417, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695011, by speed post, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General / Others: Rs. 2,500. SC/ST: Rs. 1,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on the closing date for submission of applications). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC Relaxation in the upper age limit as per the rules in force.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level-12 (₹1,01,500– 1,67,400) for Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology), Pay Matrix Level-12 (₹1,01,500– 1,67,400) for Assistant Professor (Medical Oncology), Pay Matrix Level-12 (₹1,01,500– 1,67,400) for Assistant Professor (Radiodiagnosis), Pay Matrix Level-12 (₹1,01,500– 1,67,400) for Assistant Professor (Radiation Oncology).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II or Part III of the third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956, plus MCh/DrNB/DNB (Surgical Oncology), DM/DrNB/DNB in Medical Oncology, or MD/DNB in Radiodiagnosis / Radiation Oncology with one year as Senior Resident, as per specialty. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Recruitment shall be made in accordance with the rules of reservation prevailing in the Government of Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate training or teaching experience in a department or unit not recognized or approved by the National Medical Commission for postgraduate medical education is not counted for faculty appointment.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Documents will be subjected to verification.
